''' Control Aleph-One''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|callsign]] of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] assigned to [[Revos Spaceport]]'s [[Bunker Aleph-One]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Storinal]]. During [[Wraith Squadron]]'s [[Mission to Storinal]], [[Garik Loran]] and [[Atril Tabanne]] stormed the bunker. Aleph-One tried to draw his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] but was shot by Tabanne in the face, instantly [[Death/Legends|killing]] him.<ref name="WS" />

He had a daughter named [[Sakira]], which was used as the code in order to recall the spaceport's [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter's]] back to base.<ref name="WS" />
